---
title: "How far is one value from the sample mean in standard deviations?"
---

## What the question asks

How far is one value from the sample mean in standard deviations?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Calculate the sample mean and sd().

2. Subtract the mean from the chosen value.

3. Divide by sd() if it is positive.

## Runnable example

```{r}
x <- c(10,12,14,16,18)
chosen <- 18
s <- sd(x)
if (s==0) stop("No variation: z-score is undefined.")
z <- (chosen-mean(x))/s
print(z)
```

## Interpret the result

The chosen observation 18 is approximately 1.26 sample standard deviations above the sample mean 14.

## Check before applying this to real data

Do not divide by zero when all observations are equal; a large magnitude does not establish that a measurement is an error.
